## §16.3 resolutions (ticket body, verified at run start)

- **#22** — `beautiful-mermaid@1.1.3` verified on npm: license **MIT** → on
  `licenses.allowlist.json`; no exception entry needed. Used for Mermaid→SVG in
  `packages/figures`.
- **#8** — PNG@2x via `@resvg/resvg-js@2.6.2`: license **MPL-2.0** → exception entry added to
  `licenses.exceptions.json` (npm / MPL-2.0 / "server-side SVG→PNG rasterizer in the worker
  only; weak copyleft used as an unmodified dependency; never in a client bundle").
- `vega@6.4.0` + `vega-lite@6.4.3` — BSD-3-Clause (allowlisted); `elkjs` (beautiful-mermaid
  dep) MIT.

## Requirements (from the ticket)

1. `packages/figures` renderer: Vega-Lite → schema-validated → compiled → light+dark SVG themed
   from `@rhema/tokens` (one neutral palette, label contrast ≥4.5:1, no animation); Mermaid →
   `beautiful-mermaid` same pair; GFM/HTML tables pass through unrendered; byte-identical output;
   PNG@2x lazy via `@resvg/resvg-js`; deterministic; node-only, no DOM.
2. `FigureAsset` contract + asset store: `packages/contracts/src/domain/figure.ts` over
   `figures`/`figure_versions`; alt ≤250 required + sourceLine required before insert;
   provenance {kind+refs+verification}; §7.5 directory layout under `assets/figures/<fig>/`.
3. `manifests/figure.ts` — data (judge, honesty step) → spec (generate, ≤3 retries w/ validator
   feedback) → render (package — deterministic render) → caption (generate). No Approval —
   preview-before-insert card is consent. Rhema-owned skill declared in `rhemaOwned`.
   `ESTIMATORS.figure` per REQ-VIZ-16 (first render 5–15, iterate 2–8, chips 0).
4. Honesty step (REQ-VIZ-4/5, REQ-WF-14): classify origin → 6 kinds; model-memory refused;
   insist → kind:"none" + persistent `[unverified data]` badge carried to exports; data table
   before render; cell corrections → `user_typed`.
5. Five entry points (REQ-VIZ-3): chat visualize tool sheet → run; selection popover Visualize
   (selection + anchor); `/visualize` @claim/@asset/free text; Edit figure on a block; craft
   finding Visualize action.
6. Figure card: type chips (0-cr local spec edits), caption/alt/source fields, Data/Spec/Versions
   disclosures, insert-after anchor picker, `[unverified data]` badge.
7. Iterate (REQ-VIZ-9): re-run spec gen with prior spec → `figure_versions` n+1 retaining prior
   spec/data/provenance; Versions strip (thumbnails + request text + restore); data change
   re-runs honesty step.
8. Insert-as-proposal (REQ-VIZ-10/11/12): proposal at anchor; Accept = one transaction writing
   `![alt](asset://fig_<id>)` + caption + footnoted source + `<!-- rhema:figure id=… version=n -->`;
   frozen vN → fork vN+1 + claims pending verification; Reject keeps the asset; figure numbers
   from document order.
9. Review integration (REQ-VIZ-13/14): figure claims → Tier-1 inventory from provenance.json +
   data.csv; verdict → `provenance.verification` + badge; kind:"none" → Unsupported; claims
   table groups under figure number.
10. Export packaging (REQ-VIZ-15 asset half): light SVG (never dark), PNG@2x where raster, native
    table for md/docx, alt + source footnote always, `[unverified data]` caption note.

## Plan

1. **Deps + licences:** `vega`, `vega-lite`, `beautiful-mermaid`, `@resvg/resvg-js` on
   `packages/figures`; `@rhema/tokens` dep; MPL-2.0 exception entry.
2. **Contracts** `domain/figure.ts`: specKind/provenance-kind/verification enums, FigureAsset,
   provenance schema, badge derivation, figure-block markdown builder + marker regex,
   entry-point→provenance map, export-package shape, `figure.json` sidecar (registry + hint).
3. **Figures package**: theme (light/dark vega config + mermaid DiagramColors from tokens),
   vega render (`toSVG` deterministic), mermaid render, table passthrough, `validateVegaLiteSpec`
   (compile-errors → feedback list), `renderFigurePng` (resvg lazy), contrast assertion helper.
4. **Protocols**: `skills/figure/SKILL.md` (Rhema-owned, six-input shape) + `rhemaOwned`;
   `manifests/figure.ts` (data judge → spec generate → render package → caption generate, no
   gate); `ESTIMATORS.figure`; WORKFLOW_MANIFESTS/SEAT_BY_WORKFLOW/EXPECTED registrations;
   new completion predicate `artifact_any_nonempty` (spec file is one of three names);
   `<fig>` declared-path placeholder (mounts/runspec/work-reader).
5. **Orchestrator**: `figure-delivery.ts` — finalize branch: figures + figure_versions rows
   from the harvested figure.json sidecar + spec/data artifacts; enqueue `figure.render`.
6. **Worker**: `figure.render` handler — render light+dark SVG via @rhema/figures, persist
   render artifacts + `renderedVersionId`, emit `figure.rendered`; `png` flag → render@2x.png.
7. **API** `figure-routes.ts`: list/GET DTO/PATCH (alt≤250, sourceLine gate)/data corrections
   (user_typed)/iterate/spec-chip/restore/propose/reject/png + `workflow==="figure"` branch in
   run-routes (reserve fig id, entry-point provenance, anchor).
8. **Web**: `/p/:slug/figures` pane + `/p/:slug/figures/:fig` card (chips, disclosures, anchor
   picker, badge, versions strip, insert/iterate/discard); `/visualize` verb → sheet;
   proposal card on the Page accept/reject path.
9. **Review**: figure-claims input into the claim inventory (Tier-1) + verdict write-back to
   `provenance.verification`; Unsupported when kind:"none"; group under figure number.
10. **Export**: `figureExportPackage(figure, format)` helper (SVG/PNG@2x/table/alt/footnote/
    unverified note) for P1.18.
11. Gates + build memory + PR.

## Test matrix

- figures pkg: determinism byte-equality (2 runs), light/dark themes applied, label contrast
  ≥4.5, no animation strings, vega validation errors list, mermaid render, table passthrough,
  unsupported decline w/ suggestion, PNG@2x produces PNG bytes.
- contracts: provenance/asset schemas, alt ≤250 + sourceLine insert gate, badge derivation
  (kind none / verification), figure-block builder + marker round-trip, entry-point map covers
  five entries, export package per format + unverified note.
- protocols: manifest EXPECTED row + count, skill regex, sidecar registry figure.json,
  ESTIMATORS.figure band (first 5–15, iterate 2–8, chip 0).
- orchestrator: figure delivery writes figures+figure_versions rows + enqueues render
  (PGlite); `<fig>` expansion (mounts + runspec).
- worker: figure.render handler persists render.svg/dark + renderedVersionId + event; png flag.
- api: list/GET/PATCH validation, data corrections → user_typed, iterate → n+1 version rows,
  restore, propose → proposal payload + accept writes block + fork marks claims pending,
  reject keeps asset, run-creation figure branch (provenance per entry point).
- web: figures pane + card render, badge, disclosures, anchor picker, chip edit POST (0 cr),
  /visualize → sheet never a run.
- review: figure claims in inventory input (Tier-1), verdict → verification + badge, none →
  Unsupported.

## Progress

- **Phase 1 — deps + licences.** `packages/figures` created (`vega@6.4.0`, `vega-lite@6.4.3`,
  `beautiful-mermaid@1.1.3`, `@resvg/resvg-js@2.6.2`, `@rhema/tokens`); `licenses.exceptions.json`
  gains the MPL-2.0 resvg entry; `pnpm check:licenses` green (606).
- **Phase 2a — contracts.** `domain/figure.ts` (spec/provenance/verification enums,
  `FigureAsset`, provenance schema, badge derivation, `figureBlockMarkdown` + marker regex,
  entry-point map, `figureClaims`/`figureClaimsSupported`/`verificationFromVerdicts`,
  export-package shape) + `figure.json` sidecar (schema, registry row, fixture) + tests.
- **Phase 2b — renderer.** `csv.ts`/`mermaid.ts`/`render.ts`/`validate.ts`/`png.ts`/`info.ts`:
  deterministic light+dark SVG, ≥4.5:1 contrast assert, no animation, validator feedback,
  table passthrough, lazy PNG@2x. 28 tests green.
- **Phase 2c — protocols.** `skills/figure` (Rhema-owned, declared `rhemaOwned`);
  `manifests/figure.ts` (data→spec→render→caption, no gate, spec retries ≤3 w/ validator
  feedback); `ESTIMATORS.figure` (first 5–15 / iterate 2–8 / chip 0); `WORKFLOW_MANIFESTS` +
  `SEAT_BY_WORKFLOW` rows; `<fig>` declared-path placeholder in hydration/runspec/work-reader.
- **Phase 2d — orchestrator + worker.** `figure-delivery.ts` (finalize fold → figures +
  figure_versions; iterate ⇒ n+1 snapshot; `enqueueFigureRender` post-commit, singleton on
  (figure, run, attempt)); worker `figure.render` handler (render pair persist +
  `renderedVersionId` + `figure.rendered`; `png` flag). `figure-claims.ts` (inventory +
  mount provider); `internal-api` binds the mount for review/fact_check + the render-step
  commit hook.
- **Phase 2e — API.** `figure-routes.ts` (pane/card DTOs, PATCH gates, corrections ⇒
  `user_typed`, spec-edit + restore enqueue, propose/accept/reject incl. frozen-fork via
  `saveManualRevision`, lazy PNG); run-routes `workflow:"figure"` branch (mint/verify id,
  404 on invented, entry-point provenance seed, frozen inputs).
- **Phase 2f — web.** `/p/:slug/visualize` sheet (only run creator) + `/p/:slug/figures`
  pane + figure card (chips, disclosures, anchor picker, badge, versions strip); chat
  `/visualize` redirect; popover/palette/block-edit/finding entries all converge on the
  sheet; `figureHrefFor`/`editFigureLabel` on inserted blocks; dossier figure chips.
- **Phase 2g — review + export.** `figure-claims` mount in review/fact_check hydration;
  mirror/delivery folds verdicts → `provenance.verification` + re-persists
  `provenance.json`; `claims.figure_id` persisted; `figureExportPackage` helper (light SVG /
  PNG@2x / native table / alt + footnote / unverified note) staged for P1.18.
- **Phase 3–4 — self-review + gap table.** Two real defects found + fixed in-run: the
  spec-edit SQL parameter order (figure id vs specVersionId swapped — caught by the new api
  test) and two IDE test assertions that assumed every sheet verb routes `/run?`.
- **Phase 5 — verification.** All Stage-A gates green (see Evidence log).
- **Phase 6 — build memory + PR.** D-P1.13-1 opened; LEDGER/BUILD_INDEX/pr-body updated.

## Evidence report

Stage A complete: the visualize workflow is a first-class `figure` run whose honesty step
precedes spec generation, whose render is deterministic and worker-owned, whose insertion is
proposal-only (frozen ⇒ fork), and whose `[unverified data]` badge persists into Review
(`kind:"none"` ⇒ Unsupported) and export packaging. All Stage-A gates green; the live
end-to-end + container-level resvg check is Stage B → **D-P1.13-1** (operator-gated, ≤$3).
